title: Barcelona, the card said
logline: The 2001 postcard itself, face up on the drafting table: the tram, the stamp, and beside it the Lisbon room he built from it, on a sheet, the two side by side. The page admits the card said Barcelona and draws Lisbon anyway.

panels.composition: A drafting table under the lamp: a 2001 postcard of a yellow tram face up, its stamp visible, and beside it a drawn sheet of a shuttered tiled hotel room with a coat on a chair, the two side by side in the lamp's circle.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a drafting table under a lamp with an old postcard of a yellow tram lying face up beside a drawn sheet showing a shuttered tiled hotel room with a coat on a chair, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The card and the room it made, side by side.
